description_en: Queries the deployment status of policy instances for different policy types in a cluster, including the number of enabled instances for each policy rule and the number of enabled policy types at different governance levels
description_zh: 您可以调用DescribePolicyInstancesStatus接口，查询集群当前不同策略类型对应的实例部署状态，包括每种策略规则对应开启的实例计数，以及不同治理等级下开启的策略种类计数
name: DescribePolicyInstancesStatus

instances_severity_count.description_en: The number of policy instances deployed in the cluster at different governance levels
instances_severity_count.description_zh: 集群中当前部署的不同治理等级的策略实例计数

policy_instances.description_en: The list of policy instance counts for different policy types
policy_instances.description_zh: 不同策略类型下的策略实例计数列表

policy_category.description_en: The policy type. For more information about supported policy types and their descriptions, see [Container security policy rule library]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/359819.html）
policy_category.description_zh: 策略类型。支持的策略类型和类型说明详见[容器安全策略规则库说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/359819.html）

policy_description.example: Restricts use of the cluster-admin role.

policy_instances_count.description_en: The number of deployed policy instances. If this field is empty, no policy instances of this type are deployed
policy_instances_count.description_zh: 已部署的策略实例计数，如果字段为空说明未部署该类型策略实例

policy_severity.description_en: The governance level of the policy

policy_instances.title_en: 不同策略类型下的策略实例计数列表
policy_instances.title_zh: 不同策略类型下的策略实例计数列表
